title: Our Neanderthal Neighbours
paragraphs: Neanderthals were early humans who lived in Europe and parts of Asia long ago. For many years, people thought of them as slow and simple. Today, scientists can read their DNA from old bones, and the results have changed that picture. The new story is more interesting.

When researchers compared Neanderthal DNA with the DNA of people today, they found something surprising. In the study, many of the people tested carried a small amount of Neanderthal DNA. For people in the study whose families came from outside Africa, it was usually between one and two percent. That means our ancestors and the Neanderthals had children together.

In the African people it studied, a newer study also found a little Neanderthal DNA. The scientists think that some of it may have come back with early humans. So Neanderthals are not only a part of history. A small piece of them is still inside many of us.
